component.name: WiFi2QR
component.summary: Turn this device's Wi-Fi into a scannable QR code

description.p: WiFi2QR reads the Wi-Fi network your computer is connected to and turns it into a QR code your guests can scan to join — no reading passwords aloud, no typing. Everything runs on your device; nothing is uploaded.

ul.li: One-click read of your current Wi-Fi network (via NetworkManager)
Or type any network name and password by hand
Print a full-page "Join the Wi-Fi" poster, or a sheet of cut-out cards for a hotel, café or event
Save the QR code as an image, or copy it to share
Fully offline and private — nothing leaves your device

screenshot.caption: Read this device's Wi-Fi and show the scannable code

description.p: Printable Wi-Fi posters and cut-out cards, 16 languages, and signed build provenance.
Flatpak reads Wi-Fi via NetworkManager D-Bus with a scoped permission.
Linux Flatpak support with sandboxed Wi-Fi auto-read via flatpak-spawn.
